<script>

  "use strict";

  const byId = id => document.getElementById(id);
  const numberPattern = /[-+]?(?:\d*\.?\d+)(?:[eE][-+]?\d+)?/g;
  const clamp = v => Math.max(0, Math.min(1, v));
  const round = v => Math.round(v * 10000) / 10000;

  function readPath(el) {
    const source = el.getAttribute("d");
    return {
      el,
      numbers: source.match(numberPattern).map(Number),
      pieces: source.split(numberPattern)
    };
  }

  function writePath(path, values) {
    let d = path.pieces[0];
    for (let i = 0; i < values.length; i++) {
      d += " " + round(values[i]) + " " + path.pieces[i + 1];
    }
    path.el.setAttribute("d", d);
  }

  const morphs = [];
  function morph(id, end, channel) {
    const path = readPath(byId(id));
    path.end = end.match(numberPattern).map(Number);
    path.channel = channel;
    morphs.push(path);
  }

  morph("left-body-shape",

    "M42 132C56 122 72 122 85 129C100 137 109 159 110 181L106 197C94 197 83 192 70 197L50 201 12 204C9 187 7 166 23 145Z", "b");

  morph("left-head-shape",

  const armPaths = Array.from(

  const parts = {};

  const neckFade = byId("left-neck-fade");
  const channels = [
    "h","m","lx","ly","fx","fy","la","fs",
    "wx","wy","wa","pa","hx","hy","rx","ry",
    "rnx","rny","rfx","rfy","rmx","rmy","b"

  const frames = [
    {t:0, v:[
      0,0, 0,0, 0,0, -21,1,

      1,0,0,0,0,0,0

    {t:200, v:[
      .18,.12, -1,-4, -4,-8, -16,.98,
      -9,-2,-7,-5, -7,-1, -7,2,
      0,0,1,-1,2,1,.5
    ]},
    {t:400, v:[
      .36,.23, -1,-6, -3,-10, -13,.92,
      -17,-5,-13,-10, -17,4, -7,1,
      0,0,1,0,2,0,.68
    ]},
    {t:600, v:[
      .70,.59, 9,-15, -2,-25, -8,.76,
      -24,-8,-18,-18, -12,-2, -7,1,
      0,0,1,-1,2,0,.9
    ]},
    {t:800, v:[
      .95,.96, 13,-23, -3,-31, -7,.72,
      -27,-7,-20,-21, -14,-3, -6,0,
      -1,-1,1,-2,1,-1,1
    ]},
    {t:1000, v:[
      1,1, 12,-26, -3,-32, -7,.70,
      -27,-6,-20,-22, -17,0, -7,-2,
      -1,-2,1,-3,2,-1,1
    ]},
    {t:1200, v:[
      1.015,1.015, 13,-26, -3,-32, -6,.70,
      -27,-6,-20,-22, -11,-5, -7,-2,
      0,-3,0,-4,2,-1,1.01
    ]},
    {t:1400, v:[
      1,.98, 13,-26, -3,-32, -6,.72,
      -27,-6,-20,-22, -14,-2, -6,-2,
      0,-2,0,-3,2,0,1
    ]}
  ];
  frames.push({t:1500, v:frames[frames.length - 1].v.slice()});

  function poseAt(time) {
    let i = 0;
    while (i < frames.length - 2 && time >= frames[i + 1].t) i++;
    const a = frames[i], b = frames[i + 1];
    const u = clamp((time - a.t) / (b.t - a.t));
    const eased = u * u * (3 - 2 * u);
    const pose = {};
    channels.forEach((key, j) => {
      pose[key] = a.v[j] + (b.v[j] - a.v[j]) * eased;
    });
    return pose;
  }

  function transform(id, value) {
    parts[id].setAttribute("transform", value);
  }

  function render(t) {
    const value = Number(t);
    const time = Number.isFinite(value) ? ((value % 1500) + 1500) % 1500 : 0;
    const p = poseAt(time);

    for (const path of morphs) {
      const values = path.numbers.map((start, i) => {
        let amount;
        if (path.channel === "head") {
          const y = path.numbers[i - (i % 2) + 1];
          amount = p.h + (p.b - p.h) * clamp((y - 90) / 45);
        } else {
          amount = p[path.channel];
        }
        return start + (path.end[i] - start) * amount;
      });
      writePath(path, values);
    }

    neckFade.setAttribute("y1", 108 - 16 * p.h);
    neckFade.setAttribute("y2", 142 - 16 * p.h);

    transform("left-eye-near",
      `translate(${p.lx} ${p.ly}) rotate(${p.la} 51 89)`);
    transform("left-eye-far",
      `translate(${p.fx} ${p.fy}) rotate(${13 - 18 * p.h} 90 95) translate(90 95) scale(${p.fs} ${1 - .07 * p.h}) translate(-90 -95)`);
    transform("left-resting-hand",
      `translate(${-p.h} ${-2 * p.h})`);
    transform("left-writing-hand",
      `translate(${p.wx} ${p.wy + 1}) rotate(${p.wa} 33 200) translate(31 200) scale(1.08 1.03) translate(-31 -200)`);
    transform("left-writing-pencil",
      `translate(${p.wx} ${p.wy - 6 * p.h}) rotate(${p.pa} 34 199)`);

    transform("right-head", `translate(${p.rx} ${p.ry})`);
    transform("right-eye-near",
      `translate(${p.rnx} ${p.rny}) rotate(-8 148 73)`);
    transform("right-eye-far",
      `translate(${p.rfx} ${p.rfy}) rotate(-8 119 73)`);
    transform("right-mouth", `translate(${p.rmx} ${p.rmy})`);
    transform("right-torso",
      `translate(${p.rx * .16} ${p.ry * .12})`);
    transform("right-rear-hand",
      `translate(${-2 * p.h} ${-13 * p.h})`);

    for (const path of armPaths) {
      const values = path.numbers.slice();
      for (let i = 0; i < values.length; i += 2) {
        const x = path.numbers[i];
        const y = path.numbers[i + 1];
        const wristWeight = clamp((200 - x) / 87);
        values[i] = x + p.hx * wristWeight + p.rx * .22 * (1 - wristWeight);
        values[i + 1] = y + p.hy * wristWeight + p.ry * .18 * (1 - wristWeight);
      }
      writePath(path, values);
    }
    transform("right-hugging-hand", `translate(${p.hx} ${p.hy})`);
    transform("belly-contact-shadow", `translate(${p.hx} ${p.hy})`);
  }

  window.nwb = {render};
  render(0);
